entities.name: Lubomír Zajíček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lubomír Zajíček was a Czech volleyball player who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1968 Summer Olympics and in the 1972 Summer Olympics. He was born in Bystrc. In 1968, he was part of the Czechoslovak team that won the bronze medal in the Olympic tournament. He played two matches. Four years later, he finished sixth with the Czechoslovak team in the 1972 Olympic tournament.
